scope: tools/list output and refusal schemas for system feature tracker and execution progress MCP surface

observed_contract.output_schema: bounded JSON schemas are advertised for catalog, observations, intent decision, and execution progress tools
observed_contract.error_schema: bounded refusal envelope is advertised for every development MCP tool
observed_contract.refusal_semantics: unknown, malformed, or mutating intents remain fail-closed and non-authoritative

limits: does not prove runtime MCP availability
does not grant execution authority, release authority, or admission
